method: Web searches for New Zealand trailer manufacturers, importers, dealers, hire fleets and rural/hardware chains, then each business's own website (and Trade Me store pages where a business has no site) read for contact details and sourcing. Facts below are as published on the cited pages; 'inference' marks our interpretation. Focus: buyers who could take several containers a month.

market.title: NZ Wholesaler Hit List
market.eyebrow: Pinnacle Trailers · New Zealand prospecting · researched 26 Nov 2026
market.lede_who: High-volume trailer buyers across New Zealand (importers, multi-site dealers, hire fleets and rural and hardware chains)
market.warn_customers: Check none of these already buy from you through an Australian wholesaler. Power Farming's dealers also stock Kea trailers, so expect them to compare.
market.call_note: These sell mainly through Trade Me or we couldn't read their website, so there's no email to use. Contact them through Trade Me or by phone.
market.intro_dealer: I'm with Pinnacle Trailers. We're a steel fabrication company with our own factory in India, and we build galvanised and painted trailers that ship flat-packed to dealers in Australia, where our range is already selling strongly. We're now bringing it to New Zealand.
market.intro_builder: I'm with Pinnacle Trailers. We're a steel fabrication company with our own factory in India, and we supply galvanised trailers and components to trailer businesses in Australia and now New Zealand.
market.compliance_bullet: ADR-approved drawbars and CTA-approved couplings for trailers up to 3500 kg, VINs supplied, and the build documentation your certifier needs for NZ entry certification
market.builder_compliance_bullet: ADR-approved drawbars and CTA-approved couplings up to 3500 kg, VINs supplied, and build documentation for NZ entry certification
extra_bullets: Duty-free into New Zealand once the NZ–India free trade agreement comes into force
why_compliance: ADR-approved drawbars and CTA-approved couplings to 3500 kg, VINs supplied, and build documents to support NZ entry certification.
why_price: Our own factory, no trader in between. Duty-free into NZ once the NZ–India FTA is in force.
market.support: Assembly guide supplied, with parts and warranty support.
market.fine_compliance: Drawbars are ADR approved and couplings CTA approved for trailers up to 3500 kg ATM. VINs supplied. NZ entry certification is completed by your local certifier using our build documentation.
market.meeting_ask: Would a video call on Tuesday 1 or Thursday 3 December work, or is there a better time for you?
market.bring: and we can courier a weld cut-section and our mill certificates to you beforehand so you can see the build quality first-hand.

prospects.address: 44 Neilpark Drive, East Tamaki, Auckland (also Riverhead, Kerikeri, Hamilton, Taupo and Whangarei pick-up)
prospects.sells: Single and tandem axle galvanised trailers, transporters, digger trailers, cages, covers, ramps and parts; rentals and finance. North Island only.
evidence: Website: "Trailer and transporter parts are made in China to Lucca Trailers' strict engineering specifications"
Website: "The trailers and transporters are assembled in New Zealand as further quality controls"
Website: "Made from hot-dipped galvanised steel", "3 year warranty"; six North Island locations
prospects.sourcing: Imports Chinese-made parts and assembles in NZ (stated on their website).
prospects.cater: They already buy flat-pack trailer parts from overseas and assemble locally, so we replace their Chinese supplier with no change to their workflow: same flat-pack model, certified steel, ADR-approved drawbars and pay-as-you-sell terms. Six sites means multi-container volume.
prospects.angle: Swap Chinese parts for certified Indian-built kits: same assembly line, better steel, better terms.
prospects.opener: I read that Lucca has its trailer parts made in China and assembles them here in New Zealand. That's exactly how we supply dealers, so I thought it was worth a conversation.
prospects.range_line: single and tandem galvanised trailers and transporters
prospects.meeting: by video call, or in person at East Tamaki on our next New Zealand trip

prospects.address: Auckland store: 80 Kahakaha Lane, Māngere, Auckland 2022. Christchurch showroom: 9 Commerce Crescent, Islington, Christchurch 8042
prospects.email_note: Only a general support address is published. Ask for the buyer or category manager for trailers.
prospects.sells: Large online and showroom retailer of imported goods across many categories, including 7x4 cage trailers with hot-dip galvanised beds and drawbars.
evidence: Website: "It all began in 2001 when we started importing to a small garage in central Auckland, selling on ... Trade Me"
Website: "45k+ product reviews", "50+ service agents", "100% NZ owned"; ships NZ-wide
Has sold a 7x4 single-axle cage trailer with a hot-dipped galvanised bed and drawbar
prospects.cater: A high-volume importer that sells online NZ-wide. Offer a ready-to-sell trailer range with consistent quality and documentation, mixed containers, and a private-label option for their own brand.
prospects.angle: A dependable, documented trailer supplier for a high-volume online importer, under their brand if they want.
prospects.opener: Trade Tested has built one of New Zealand's biggest import businesses since 2001. I'd like to show you a trailer range built in our own factory, with the quality paperwork to back it up.
prospects.meeting: by video call, or in person in Māngere on our next New Zealand trip

prospects.address: 3 Edison Place (corner of Dyers Road), Christchurch
prospects.email_note: No public email. Contact through their Trade Me store (Half Price Imports) or call.
prospects.sells: Galvanised single and tandem trailers (e.g. 8x4) sold through Trade Me, alongside the Half Price Imports range.
evidence: Trade Me store: "Since 2012, Gorilla Trailers has been supplying Kiwis with tough, practical trailers at competitive prices"
Listings: "100% NZ Owned, Operated & Assembled", "Fully Hot Dip Galvanised"
Trade Me store: "Both brands from one Christchurch location" (Gorilla Trailers and Half Price Imports)
prospects.sourcing: Imports and assembles in NZ (trades as Half Price Imports; listings say NZ-assembled).
prospects.cater: An importer that assembles locally and competes on price. Our factory-direct landed cost and pay-as-you-sell terms protect their margin, and certified steel gives them a quality story against cheaper imports.
prospects.angle: Better landed cost and better steel for a price-led importer.
prospects.opener: Gorilla Trailers has been supplying Kiwis with tough trailers at sharp prices since 2012. I'd like to show you how we could improve your landed cost without giving up quality.
prospects.meeting: by video call, or in person in Christchurch on our next New Zealand trip

prospects.address: Stores nationwide; approach through the merchandise/supplier team at the support office
prospects.email_note: No supplier email published. Use the supplier enquiry route on mitre10.co.nz, or ask any store for the trailer category buyer's contact.
prospects.sells: Jobmate-brand trailers in stores: 7x4 Cruiser ($1,749), 7x4 Tipping Hauler and 8x4 Charger, plus mower trailers.
evidence: Website: Jobmate Trailer Cruiser 7x4, SKU 203476, $1,749, stock shown by store
Website: Jobmate Tipping Hauler 7x4 and Charger 8x4

prospects.cater: The biggest volume opportunity on the list. Pitch to build the Jobmate trailer range under their brand, to their spec, with certified steel and NZ compliance documents. Retail buyers will want samples, testing and firm pricing, so expect a long cycle.
prospects.angle: Private-label manufacturer for the Jobmate trailer range.
prospects.opener: Mitre 10's Jobmate trailers are a staple for Kiwi DIYers. I'd like to talk about building that range in our own factory, under your brand and to your spec.
prospects.meeting: by video call, or in person in Auckland on our next New Zealand trip

prospects.email_note: Their website blocks automated reading, so no email was collected. Check tufftrailers.co.nz or call.
prospects.sells: Fully welded hot-dip galvanised trailers (e.g. 7x4 with removable 800 mm cage), NZ-wide delivery, finance.
evidence: Trade Me: "NZ's #1 Trailer Company | 5 Year Warranty | 0800 69 88 33"
Trade Me: "over 800+ 5-star reviews"
Listing: "a brand new fully welded hot dip galvanised trailer NOT a bolt together kitset"
prospects.sourcing: Not stated. They sell fully welded trailers, not kitsets, so offer fully welded units as well as flat-pack.
prospects.cater: A high-volume, review-driven seller. They stress 'fully welded, not a kitset', so lead with our fully welded options and certified welds, and back their 5-year warranty with mill and welder certificates.
prospects.angle: Second supplier of fully welded galvanised trailers that can carry their 5-year warranty.
prospects.opener: Tuff Trailers has built a huge following with fully welded galvanised trailers and an 800-plus review track record. I'd like to show you a second source that can carry your 5-year warranty.
prospects.range_line: fully welded galvanised box and cage trailers
prospects.meeting: by video call, or in person in Papakura on our next New Zealand trip

prospects.sells: Stockist of the full GT Trailers range (NZ-engineered, hot-dip galvanised, 2-year guarantee), plus jockey wheels and trailer parts.
evidence: Website: "partnered with GT Trailers to bring you their full range of trailers"
Website: GT trailers are "NZ-engineered, hot-dip galvanised, 2-year guarantee"
prospects.cater: A reseller, not a builder, so they can add a second range easily. Offer a value-to-premium range with pay-as-you-sell terms and a mixed trial container.
prospects.angle: Second range with better margin and no stock risk.
prospects.opener: Auto Trailer has built a strong Waikato business on the GT Trailers range. I'd like to show you a second range that could add margin alongside it.
prospects.range_line: galvanised box, cage and tandem trailers
prospects.meeting: by video call, or in person in Hamilton on our next New Zealand trip

prospects.address: Branches nationwide (vehicle rental arm: 9 branches in all major centres)
prospects.email_note: General address. Ask for the fleet or procurement manager for trailers.
prospects.sells: Equipment and vehicle hire, including cage/high-side, furniture, standard/low-side and transport trailers.
evidence: Website: trailer hire categories for cage/high-side, furniture, standard/low-side and transport trailers
Hirepool Vehicle Rentals: "9 branches conveniently located nationwide, including all major centres"
prospects.cater: A national hire fleet that replaces trailers on a cycle. Hire trailers take a beating, so lead with certified welds, heavy galvanising, fewer repairs between hires, and fleet pricing on a mixed container.
prospects.angle: Tougher fleet trailers at a fleet price: lower cost per hire.
prospects.opener: Hirepool runs one of New Zealand's biggest hire trailer fleets. I'd like to show you a fully galvanised range built to take hire-fleet punishment, at a fleet price.
prospects.range_line: cage, furniture, standard and transport trailers

prospects.opener: Hireace's one-way trailer hire puts a lot of kilometres on your fleet. I'd like to show you a fully galvanised range built for exactly that, at a fleet price.

prospects.address: Main office: 145 Maui Street, Te Rapa, Hamilton. Christchurch: 4 Green Lane, Sockburn
prospects.sells: Light trailers of all types, made in NZ, sold from Hamilton and Christchurch and through a nationwide dealer network (Honda, Power Farming and machinery dealers).
evidence: Website: "the leading light trailer manufacturer in New Zealand" with "40+ years experience"
Website: "100% New Zealand Made"; dealers from Kerikeri to Christchurch
prospects.cater: NZ's leading light-trailer builder, with an NZ-made brand. Don't pitch finished trailers against it. Offer galvanised chassis, drawbars and sub-assemblies to add capacity, or a separately branded value range for their dealer network.
prospects.angle: Capacity and component partner, never a replacement for their NZ-made line.
prospects.opener: Kea is New Zealand's leading light-trailer builder. I'm reaching out to ask whether galvanised chassis, drawbars or sub-assemblies from our steel fabrication plant could help with capacity.
prospects.meeting: by video call, or in person in Hamilton on our next New Zealand trip

prospects.address: 29 Station Road, Te Puke, Bay of Plenty

evidence: Website: "over 50 years of experience designing and building trailers for the New Zealand market"
Website: "While it is almost impossible to build a trailer solely from NZ made components, we strive to ensure that the majority of materials and components are manufactured in NZ"
prospects.sourcing: NZ manufacturer that already uses some imported components.
prospects.cater: They openly use some imported components, so offer certified components (drawbars, couplings, chassis) to cut their build time.
prospects.angle: Certified components that speed up their build.
prospects.opener: Prescott has built trailers in Te Puke for over 50 years. I wanted to ask whether certified galvanised drawbars, chassis or sub-assemblies could help speed up your builds.
prospects.meeting: by video call, or in person in Te Puke on our next New Zealand trip
